items.summary: Replace the empty/mock provider list on the Client "Provider Results" page with real backend data so a logged-in client can see every service provider for the selected category (and also support viewing "All Providers" when no category filter is provided).

Add/extend a backend query API that returns a list of provider profiles suitable for client browsing (including each provider’s current engagement state), and ensure it is callable by authenticated clients.
Update the client provider listing UI so each provider card clearly shows engagement status (Engaged / Not Engaged) in English, for every provider in the results grid.

Add React Query wiring for the new/updated provider list query and integrate it into `frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResultsPage.tsx`, including loading and error states with English user-facing text.
